title: 窗子天窗
teacherNotes: Teacher-approved final source for L152 窗. Use these sentences exactly; spokenText equals text with punctuation removed. Latest origin/main includes L147 間, so L152 depends on unmerged L148 時, L149 還, L150 燈, and L151 關. Do not merge production JSON until L148-L151 are present in latest origin/main. Provisional learned chars are 時, 還, 燈, 關. Use Taiwan Traditional Chinese and Taiwan zhuyin only; do not use Hanyu pinyin. Use 為, not 爲; use 裡, not 裏. Do not add unlearned display characters such as 車, 電, 動, 玻, 璃, 亮, or 暗. Sentence 4 is a car-interior rainy-day image scene, but 車 must not appear in displayed lesson text or in any readable image text. Images must use L058 style anchors and contain no text, numbers, zhuyin, labels, signs, letters, logos, written UI, license plates, dashboard text, or watermarks. Audio must be standalone OpenAI charAudio, whole-sentence AI audio, independent G02 prefix/suffix, and independent G05 wrong-choice whole-sentence audio, processed through assets:audio and AI-aligned before production release.

approvedSentences.scene: A small dog sits or stands by a window looking outside at a street lamp. Make the window and street lamp clear. No signs, words, numbers, labels, or logos.

approvedSentences.text: 出門前要關窗，還要關燈。
approvedSentences.spokenText: 出門前要關窗還要關燈
approvedSentences.scene: A living room or home entry scene before going out. A person is closing a window and turning off or preparing to turn off a light. No written labels, switch labels, signs, or numbers.

approvedSentences.text: 時間還沒到，還可以玩一下。
approvedSentences.spokenText: 時間還沒到還可以玩一下
approvedSentences.scene: A child continues playing because it is not time to stop yet. Show play activity and an adult nearby. Do not show readable clock numbers, schedules, labels, or text.

approvedSentences.text: 下雨時，要關天窗，開大燈。
approvedSentences.spokenText: 下雨時要關天窗開大燈
approvedSentences.scene: Rainy-day car interior scene: the roof window or sunroof is being closed because it is raining, and bright front lights are on. Do not include the unlearned character 車 anywhere in the image. No dashboard text, numbers, icons, labels, license plates, or signs.

approvedSentences.text: 媽媽關心我在學校過得怎樣。
